policy: Do not silently replace a room's model or apply one vendor's sampler to all models.

notes: Preserve first-person Chinese group conversation and explicit identity aliases.
Keep safety handling short and contextual; roleplay is not a policy override.
Verify the adapter API and multimodal support separately from personality.
Inspect selected room model; a global default does not necessarily override an existing conversation.
Inspect actual resolved route and accumulated history; do not infer the backend from a model alias alone.
